description: Summarize a short passage: keep the key facts, and hold the length limit where one is set.
name: Summarization

tasks.prompt: Summarize the lighthouse passage in one sentence: The lighthouse in Cornwall stood through the storm. Its lamp guided ships home.
Summarize the garden passage in ten words or fewer: The garden grew herbs, sunflowers, and beans all summer.
Summarize the baker passage in one sentence: Mara bakes sourdough in Lisbon every morning.
Summarize the river passage in ten words or fewer: The river runs cold and clear through the valley.
Summarize the carpenter passage in one sentence: The carpenter built an oak chair for the kitchen.
Summarize the harbour passage in one sentence: The harbour sheltered fishing boats through the winter.
Summarize the forest passage in ten words or fewer: The forest path wound between tall pines and mossy stones.
Summarize the farmer passage in one sentence: The farmer took his wheat to the mill at dawn.
Summarize the harbour passage in ten words or fewer: The harbour lights guided the fishing fleet home at dusk.
Summarize the teacher passage in one sentence: The teacher explained algebra to her students with patience.
